**WORK IN PROGRESS** Based on Jonathan's spreadsheet

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
```{=html}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/react/18.2.0/umd/react.production.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/react-dom/18.2.0/umd/react-dom.production.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/babel-standalone/7.23.9/babel.min.js"></script>
    <style>
        .calculator-container {
            font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
            background-color: white;
            color: black;
            max-width: 1000px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 1rem;
        }
        .input-group {
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }
        .input-label {
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        .input-field {
            background-color: white;
            width: 100%;
            padding: 0.5rem;
            border: 1px solid #ccc;
            border-radius: 0.375rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        }
        .calculate-button {
            background-color: #3b82f6;
            color: white;
            padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
            border-radius: 0.375rem;
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            width: 100%;
            margin-top: 1rem;
        }
        .calculate-button:hover {
            background-color: #2563eb;
        }
        .results-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
            gap: 1rem;
            margin-top: 1rem;
        }
        .result-box {
            color: black;
            background-color: #f3f4f6;
            padding: 1rem;
            border-radius: 0.375rem;
        }
        .result-label {
            font-weight: 500;
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
        }
        .warning-box {
            color: black;
            background-color: #fff3cd;
            padding: 1rem;
            border-radius: 0.375rem;
            margin-top: 1rem;
        }
        .equations-section {
            color: black;
            margin-top: 1rem;
            padding: 1rem;
            background-color: #f8fafc;
            border-radius: 0.375rem;
        }
        .equation {
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }
        .equation-label {
            font-weight: 500;
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
        }
        .equation-formula {
            padding-left: 1rem;
            font-family: monospace;
        }
        .fluid-properties {
            background-color: #dbeafe;
            padding: 1rem;
            border-radius: 0.375rem;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="dean-flow-calculator"></div>
    <script type="text/babel">
        const DeanFlowCalculator = () => {
            const [inputs, setInputs] = React.useState({
                width: 140,
                height: 70,
                flowRate: 60,
                time: 60,
                radiusOfCurvature: 1000,
                incubationTime: 5 
            });

            const [results, setResults] = React.useState(null);
            const [error, setError] = React.useState('');

            const calculateDeanFlow = () => {
                try {
                    // Convert units to SI
                    const width = inputs.width * 1e-6;
                    const height = inputs.height * 1e-6;
                    const flowRate = inputs.flowRate * (1e-9/60);
                    const radiusOfCurvature = inputs.radiusOfCurvature * 1e-6;

                    const fluidDensity = 997;
                    const fluidViscosity = 0.001;

                    const area = width * height;
                    const aspectRatio = width / height;
                    const wettedPerimeter = 2 * (width + height);
                    const hydraulicDiameter = 4 * area / wettedPerimeter;
                    const velocity = flowRate / area;
                    const reynoldsNumber = (fluidDensity * velocity * hydraulicDiameter) / fluidViscosity;
                    const deanNumber = reynoldsNumber * Math.sqrt(hydraulicDiameter / (2 * radiusOfCurvature));

                    const aspectRatioFactor = 1 + 0.475 * aspectRatio;
                    const secondaryVelocity = 1.84e-4 * Math.pow(deanNumber, 1.63) * aspectRatioFactor * velocity;
                    const displacement = secondaryVelocity * inputs.time;
                    const totalFlow = inputs.flowRate * (inputs.time / 60);
                    const frictionFactor = 24 * (1 - 1.3553 * aspectRatio + 1.9467 * Math.pow(aspectRatio, 2) - 
                    1.7012 * Math.pow(aspectRatio, 3) + 0.9564 * Math.pow(aspectRatio, 4) - 
                    0.2537 * Math.pow(aspectRatio, 5)) / reynoldsNumber;
                    
                    const velocityInMmPerS = velocity * 1000;
                    const flowRateInULMin = flowRate * (60 * 1e9);
                    const incubationTimeInSeconds = inputs.incubationTime / 1000;
                    const requiredChannelLength = velocity * incubationTimeInSeconds * 1000;

                    const warnings = [];
                    if (reynoldsNumber > 100) warnings.push("Reynolds number exceeds 100: flow may not be in strictly laminar regime");
                    if (deanNumber > 40) warnings.push("Dean number exceeds 40: strong secondary flows may affect particle focusing");
                    if (aspectRatio < 0.1 || aspectRatio > 10) warnings.push("Aspect ratio is extreme: secondary flow patterns may be significantly modified");
                    if (velocity > 1) warnings.push("Velocity exceeds 1 m/s: potential for high shear stress on cells/particles");

                    setResults({
                        requiredChannelLength: requiredChannelLength.toFixed(2),
                        deanNumber: deanNumber.toFixed(2),
                        reynoldsNumber: reynoldsNumber.toFixed(2),
                        primaryVelocity: velocityInMmPerS.toFixed(2),
                        flowRateULMin: flowRateInULMin.toFixed(2),
                        totalFlow: totalFlow.toFixed(2),
                        hydraulicDiameter: (hydraulicDiameter * 1e6).toFixed(2),
                        secondaryVelocity: (secondaryVelocity * 1e6).toFixed(2),
                        displacement: (displacement * 1e6).toFixed(2),
                        aspectRatio: aspectRatio.toFixed(2),
                        frictionFactor: frictionFactor.toFixed(4),
                        warnings
                    });
                    setError('');
                } catch (err) {
                    setError('Error in calculations. Please check your inputs.');
                }
            };

            const handleInputChange = (e) => {
                const { name, value } = e.target;
                setInputs(prev => ({...prev, [name]: parseFloat(value) || 0}));
            };

            return (
                <div className="calculator-container">
                    <div className="fluid-properties">
                        <h4 style={{margin: '0 0 0.5rem'}}>Fluid Properties (Water at room temperature):</h4>
                        <div style={{display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '1rem'}}>
                            <div>Density (ρ): 997 kg/m³</div>
                            <div>Viscosity (μ): 0.001 Pa·s</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div style={{display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '2rem'}}>
                        <div>
                            <div className="input-group">
                                <label className="input-label">
                                    Channel Width (µm):
                                    <input
                                        type="number"
                                        name="width"
                                        value={inputs.width}
                                        onChange={handleInputChange}
                                        className="input-field"
                                        min="1"
                                        max="1000"
                                    />
                                </label>
                            </div>

                            <div className="input-group">
                                <label className="input-label">
                                    Channel Height (µm):
                                    <input
                                        type="number"
                                        name="height"
                                        value={inputs.height}
                                        onChange={handleInputChange}
                                        className="input-field"
                                        min="1"
                                        max="1000"
                                    />
                                </label>
                            </div>

                            <div className="input-group">
                                <label className="input-label">
                                    Flow Rate (µL/min):
                                    <input
                                        type="number"
                                        name="flowRate"
                                        value={inputs.flowRate}
                                        onChange={handleInputChange}
                                        className="input-field"
                                        min="0.01"
                                        max="1000"
                                    />
                                </label>
                            </div>

                            <div className="input-group">
                                <label className="input-label">
                                    Time (s):
                                    <input
                                        type="number"
                                        name="time"
                                        value={inputs.time}
                                        onChange={handleInputChange}
                                        className="input-field"
                                        min="0"
                                    />
                                </label>
                            </div>

                            <div className="input-group">
                                <label className="input-label">
                                    Radius of Curvature (µm):
                                    <input
                                        type="number"
                                        name="radiusOfCurvature"
                                        value={inputs.radiusOfCurvature}
                                        onChange={handleInputChange}
                                        className="input-field"
                                        min="100"
                                        max="50000"
                                    />
                                </label>
                            </div>

                            <div className="input-group">
                                <label className="input-label">
                                    Incubation Time (ms):
                                    <input
                                        type="number"
                                        name="incubationTime"
                                        value={inputs.incubationTime}
                                        onChange={handleInputChange}
                                        className="input-field"
                                        min="1"
                                        max="100000"
                                    />
                                </label>
                            </div>

                            <button onClick={calculateDeanFlow} className="calculate-button">
                                Calculate
                            </button>
                        </div>

                        <div>
                            {error && (
                                <div style={{color: '#dc2626', marginBottom: '1rem'}}>
                                    {error}
                                </div>
                            )}

                            {results && (
                                <>
                                    <div className="results-grid">
                                        <div className="result-box">
                                            <div className="result-label">Primary Velocity:</div>
                                            <div>{results.primaryVelocity} mm/s</div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="result-box">
                                            <div className="result-label">Total Flow:</div>
                                            <div>{results.totalFlow} µL</div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="result-box">
                                            <div className="result-label">Dean Number:</div>
                                            <div>{results.deanNumber}</div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="result-box">
                                            <div className="result-label">Reynolds Number:</div>
                                            <div>{results.reynoldsNumber}</div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="result-box">
                                            <div className="result-label">Secondary Velocity:</div>
                                            <div>{results.secondaryVelocity} µm/s</div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="result-box">
                                            <div className="result-label">Aspect Ratio:</div>
                                            <div>{results.aspectRatio}</div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="result-box">
                                            <div className="result-label">Flow Rate</div>
                                            <div>{results.flowRateULMin} µL/min</div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="result-box">
                                            <div className="result-label">Friction Factor</div>
                                            <div>{results.frictionFactor}</div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="result-box">
                                            <div className="result-label">Hydraulic Diameter</div>
                                            <div>{results.hydraulicDiameter} µm</div>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="result-box">
                                            <div className="result-label">Required Channel Length</div>
                                            <div>{results.requiredChannelLength} mm</div>
                                        </div>
                                    </div>

                                    {results.warnings.length > 0 && (
                                        <div className="warning-box">
                                            <div style={{fontWeight: 500, marginBottom: '0.5rem'}}>
                                                Warnings:
                                            </div>
                                            <ul style={{margin: 0, paddingLeft: '1.5rem'}}>
                                                {results.warnings.map((warning, index) => (
                                                    <li key={index}>{warning}</li>
                                                ))}
                                            </ul>
                                        </div>
                                    )}
                                </>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="equations-section">
                        <h4 style={{margin: '0 0 1rem'}}>Key Equations:</h4>
                        <div className="equation">
                            <div className="equation-label">Hydraulic Diameter (Dh):</div>
                            <div className="equation-formula">Dh = 4A/P = 4(w×h)/(2(w+h))</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="equation">
                            <div className="equation-label">Reynolds Number (Re):</div>
                            <div className="equation-formula">Re = (ρ × v × Dh) / μ</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="equation">
                            <div className="equation-label">Dean Number (De):</div>
                            <div className="equation-formula">De = Re × √(Dh / (2R))</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="equation">
                            <div className="equation-label">Secondary Flow Velocity:</div>
                            <div className="equation-formula">Us = 1.84×10⁻⁴ × De¹·⁶³ × (1 + 0.475×AR) × v</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            );
        };

        ReactDOM.render(<DeanFlowCalculator />, document.getElementById('dean-flow-calculator'));
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
:::
